responsibility: Implements the front end's path and filename utilities used for module discovery, output naming, and filesystem checks. `FileName` handles path joining, splitting search paths, absolute and canonical path conversion, extension and basename extraction, directory creation, safe search-path resolution, and existence checks across POSIX and Windows semantics.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the filename pair: it defines FileName’s path manipulation, canonicalization, search-path, existence, and directory-creation routines. Unlike filename.h, it supplies the cross-platform filesystem logic used by both File and higher-level module lookup code.
